data.question: Do two-constructor data recursors over transparent aliases of depths 1 and 4 produce delta/iota demand and profile disagreement?
data.versions: Retained LazyLean Darwin binary, Python 3.10; current session model with two bounded delegates for separate trials.
data.commands: python3 explorations/runs/EXPLORE-SEMANTIC-DATA-RECURSION-1/screen.py --prepare; python3 explorations/runs/EXPLORE-SEMANTIC-DATA-RECURSION-1/screen.py attempt-0001 (host retry attempt-0002 only if monitor preflight denied)
data.sample: Two alias depths x candidate/control x subst/KAM-mode-3 = eight cells; nonrecursive data Sort 1 with two nullary constructors and distinct branch types.
data.controls: Controls must ACCEPT; candidate matching ACCEPT requires positive KAM delta and iota at both depths. Recognized ACCEPT/semantic rejection difference is a candidate signal requiring diagnostic review; unknown output/process errors or missing demand are INCONCLUSIVE. Positive RSS and safe cleanup required; halt on control failures.
